# Pinly

> For the full detailed version, see https://pinly.tech/llms-full.txt

Pinly is a free, private memory map web application at https://pinly.tech/.
It lets people save places, dates, notes, and photos as memories,
then revisit them on a map and chronological timeline. Pinly can be used
individually or shared with an invited person.

## Product facts

- Pinly is free to use: each map holds up to 50 memories, with up to 3 photos per memory and 3 map styles.
- Personal memories are private by default.
- Shared content is available only to invited members.
- Pinly is a Progressive Web App and can be added to a phone Home Screen.

Use the canonical pages above as the source for current product information.
